newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish NFI 11 makes Q1 PLN 26.9 mln net profit.
newsitem.headline: Polish NFI 11 makes Q1 PLN 26.9 mln net profit.

text.p: National Investment Fund (NFI) No. 11 in Poland's mass privatisation scheme made a net profit of 26.9 million zlotys in the first quarter of 1997, the fund said in a statement on Tuesday.
NFI 11, which did not report results for the first quarter of 1996, made a net loss of 30.8 million zlotys for all of that year.
NFI 11 said its net assets amounted to 400.7 million zlotys in the first quarter of 1997.
Under the government's NFI programme, shares in about 500 mid-sized companies are allocated to 15 NFIs run by foreign and domestic management firms.

From May 12, the 26 million Poles who bought a participation unit in the scheme have been entitled to exchange it for 15 shares, one in each fund, which are expected to start trade on the Warsaw bourse at mid-year.
The units lose their validity on December 31, 1998.
